name: Range slider
purpose: Let a person set a lowest and a highest value, such as a budget or a price range.
description: Two labelled sliders for one interval, with the interval written above them. The form sends both ends as a list: lowest, then highest.

label.description: What the interval measures. It names the control and, with no name prop, the key its value is sent under.

name.description: The key the value is sent under, such as "email". Left out, it is the label in camelCase: "Work email" is sent as workEmail.

min.description: Lowest value a person can choose.

max.description: Highest value a person can choose.

step.description: Distance between values a person can choose.

low.description: Where the low end starts. Defaults to min.

high.description: Where the high end starts. Defaults to max.

unit.description: Unit written with every figure: "$" leads it; "%" and words such as "seats" follow it.

hint.description: Help that stays under the field and is read with it, such as a format or a limit.
